title: Caesar's Rubicon → Palpatine's Emergency Powers
hook: A general crosses a river, a chancellor accepts 'temporary' powers. Lucas has said he was watching Rome.

hook: 1453: the last Roman emperor on the walls. M31: the last stand at the Imperial Palace.

title: The Varangian Guard → The Adeptus Custodes
hook: Norse axemen guarding a Byzantine throne, and the golden giants who guard the Emperor's.

hook: Boys taken at seven, forged into warriors: the real Spartan system and the Astartes recruit trials.

hook: Why George Lucas pictured a superpower losing to forest fighters with sticks and stones.

hook: Secret cities, brilliant engineers, a weapon that changes everything, and the question of who is responsible.

hook: Genghis Khan's riders and Jaghatai Khan's Legion: speed, loyalty, and an empire on horseback.

hook: Why a Texas divorce court splits property like a Visigothic king, and whether the Moors had anything to do with it.

hook: The most famous image of a bad emperor, put on trial against the sources.

title: Edison vs. Tesla: The Myth of the Lone Genius

hook: A rule nobody designed, a deleted motion, and two centuries of arguing about it, from both sides.

title: From Athens to the Federalist Papers: Why Power Is Split
hook: Ostracism, Roman consuls and Madison's 'ambition must counteract ambition': the long idea behind checks and balances.
